name: Estratégia Nacional de Cibersegurança
owner: Gabinete de Segurança Institucional da Presidência da República
description: Second-generation national cybersecurity strategy, published August 4, 2025, replacing the 2020 strategy. Emphasizes digital sovereignty, resilience, and critical-services protection alongside PNCiber (secid:regulation/gov.br/gsi/pnciber).
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Gabinete de Segurança Institucional da Presidência da República (gov.br/gsi) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Gabinete de Segurança Institucional da Presidência da República (gov.br/gsi).
